description: Debug Rust, C and C++ programs with CodeLLDB, prepared on demand, or an installed LLDB DAP adapter.
setting.codeLldbPath: Optional CodeLLDB executable on the execution environment. Leave empty to download and cache the verified runtime when first used.
setting.codeLldbArgs: Additional CodeLLDB adapter arguments. Program arguments belong in launch.json.
setting.runtimeDirectory: Absolute directory for managed CodeLLDB runtimes on the execution environment. Leave empty to use its user cache. The same directory can be prefilled for development or offline use.
setting.adapterPath: Path or command name of the installed lldb-dap executable on the execution environment. Restart debugging after changing it.
setting.adapterArgs: Arguments passed to lldb-dap. Program arguments belong in launch.json.
error.adapterSettings: LLDB executable settings must be paths or command names, arguments and sourceLanguages must be string arrays without NUL characters, and debug.lldb.runtimeDirectory must be empty or absolute.
error.program: LLDB launch configuration requires a non-empty program path.
error.transport: Unable to connect to the CodeLLDB adapter
progress.retry: CodeLLDB: installation failed, click to retry
error.install: Could not prepare CodeLLDB: {0}. Run 'LLDB: Install or Retry Debugger' to retry.
error.integrity: CodeLLDB download failed SHA-256 verification. Nothing was installed. Run 'LLDB: Install or Retry Debugger' to retry.
error.unsupported: A managed CodeLLDB runtime is unavailable for this execution platform. Configure debug.lldb.codeLldbPath to use an installed adapter.
error.busy: CodeLLDB is being prepared in another cache directory. Cancel the installation before changing debug.lldb.runtimeDirectory.
